title: VTC: add ask-to-unmute moderator action
description: Jitsi and Zoom have ask-to-unmute: moderator sends a request, participant sees a prompt, participant chooses whether to unmute. The draft only has hard-mute (moderator patches mediaState.audio to false). Add either a VTCUnmuteRequestEvent ephemeral event or an unmuteRequested (Boolean) field on VTCParticipant that the moderator can set and the participant clears by unmuting or dismissing.
close_reason: Added unmuteRequested field on VTCParticipant and VTCUnmuteRequestEvent ephemeral event. Moderator ask-to-unmute action defined in participant-level moderator actions.
